slos.name: Availability
slos.sli: good requests / valid requests during business hours (4xx client errors are not valid requests)

slos.name: Latency
slos.sli: share of successful drafts completed within 8 s (streamed; full draft)

slos.name: Draft quality
slos.sli: share of sampled drafts scoring >= 4/5 on the agreed rubric (calibrated LLM judge)

slos.name: Cost per completed letter
slos.sli: model spend (drafting + judging) / letters approved as-is or after edits

exclusions: Scheduled maintenance announced at least 72 hours ahead
Outages of customer-owned dependencies (ClaimCore) declared by Harbor Mutual IT

error_budget_policy.action: Feature freeze: only reliability and security changes ship until 30-day availability is back above the SLO.
Blameless postmortem within 5 business days for any incident that consumed more than 20% of the monthly budget.
Double the judge sample next month and run every prompt change against the eval suite before release.

judge.calibration: Calibrated monthly against 50 human-graded drafts; April agreement 88% (target >= 85%).
